# IMPERIA COLD WAR — OPEC 1970 (scripted triggers).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_OPEC_generator/build.py (do not edit by hand).

# Country scope. The country whose weekly and monthly pulse drives the OPEC clock (the first to pulse; the next one if it vanishes).
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_clock = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { global.cwop_clock = THIS.id }
		check_variable = { global.cwop_clock = 0 }
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.cwop_clock > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwop_clock = { exists = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Full member of OPEC (votes at the Conference).
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = {
	check_variable = { cwop_status = 5 }
}

# Country scope. Associate member (Statute Art. 7 D): a seat without a vote.
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_associate = {
	check_variable = { cwop_status = 3 }
}

# Country scope. Observer at the Conference (Statute Art. 11 D).
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_observer = {
	check_variable = { cwop_status = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Member with suspended membership (no vote, no obligations).
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_suspended = {
	check_variable = { cwop_status = 4 }
}

# Country scope. An application or an accepted invitation waits for the Conference.
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_candidate = {
	check_variable = { cwop_status = 2 }
}

# Country scope. Founder member (Baghdad 1960): its vote is needed for every admission.
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_founder = {
	has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_founder
}

# Country scope. Member of the Organisation of Arab Petroleum Exporting Countries.
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_oapec = {
	check_variable = { cwop_oapec = 1 }
}

# Country scope. An Arab state (OAPEC can only take Arab oil exporters).
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_arab = {
	OR = { original_tag = ALG original_tag = BHR original_tag = EGY original_tag = IRQ original_tag = JOR original_tag = KUW original_tag = LBA original_tag = LEB original_tag = MOR original_tag = OMA original_tag = QAT original_tag = SAU original_tag = SUD original_tag = SYR original_tag = TUN original_tag = UAE original_tag = YEM }
}

# Country scope. A full member governed by a player right now.
COLDWAR_OPEC_player_member = {
	is_ai = no
	check_variable = { cwop_status = 5 }
}

# Country scope. Governed by a player now or in the last 365 days (an absent player keeps his rights).
COLDWAR_OPEC_seen_player = {
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_player_seen
	}
}

# Any scope. At least one full member is governed by a player.
COLDWAR_OPEC_any_player_member = {
	any_of_scopes = {
		array = global.cwop_members
		is_ai = no
	}
}

# Country scope. Exports more oil than it uses (Imperia export surplus or exporter spirit) - Statute Art. 7 C.
COLDWAR_OPEC_net_exporter = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { imp_oil_export_surplus > 0 }
		mdcw_cw_is_oil_exporter = yes
		AND = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized original_tag = SAU }
	}
}

# Country scope. Produces oil at all (MP freedom: may become an associate member).
COLDWAR_OPEC_oil_producer = {
	OR = {
		COLDWAR_OPEC_net_exporter = yes
		check_variable = { resource_produced@oil > 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Uses more oil than it produces.
COLDWAR_OPEC_net_importer = {
	check_variable = { resource_consumed@oil > resource_produced@oil }
}

# Country scope. Leads the Secretariat (the Secretary General, or the President of the Conference while the office is vacant, as 1983-88).
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_sg = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { global.cwop_sg = THIS.id }
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.cwop_sg = 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwop_pres = THIS.id }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. A Conference sits (ordinary or extraordinary).
COLDWAR_OPEC_in_session = {
	check_variable = { global.cwop_sess > 0 }
}

# Country scope. Member of the Western bloc (Cold War system).
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_west = {
	check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Member of the Soviet or the Beijing bloc.
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_east = {
	OR = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
}

# Country scope. A developing economy (Imperia tier 3).
COLDWAR_OPEC_is_developing = {
	has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_3_dynamic_modifier }
}

# Any scope. A joint embargo runs.
COLDWAR_OPEC_any_joint_embargo = {
	OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target > 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target > 0 } }
}

# Country scope. Debt above 40 % of GDP or an empty treasury (KI-Lite: wants a higher price).
COLDWAR_OPEC_needs_money = {
	OR = {
		check_variable = { debt_ratio > 0.4 }
		check_variable = { treasury < 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. May stand for Secretary General (a candidacy is open; two terms at most).
COLDWAR_OPEC_may_stand = {
	check_variable = { global.cwop_s9_phase = 1 }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_player_member = yes
	NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwop_cands value = THIS } }
	check_variable = { global.cwop_cands^num < 4 }
	NOT = { check_variable = { cwop_sg_terms > 1 } }
	has_political_power > 49
}

# Any scope. The Secretariat has a free file.
COLDWAR_OPEC_free_file = {
	OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_phase = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_phase = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_phase = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_phase = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_phase = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_phase = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_phase = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_phase = 0 } }
}

# Country scope. An application or invitation for this country is already in a file.
COLDWAR_OPEC_admission_busy = {
	OR = { AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_target = THIS.id } OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s1_item = 42 } } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_target = THIS.id } OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s2_item = 42 } } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_target = THIS.id } OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s3_item = 42 } } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_target = THIS.id } OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s4_item = 42 } } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_target = THIS.id } OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s5_item = 42 } } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_target = THIS.id } OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s6_item = 42 } } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_target = THIS.id } OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s7_item = 42 } } } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_target = THIS.id } OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_item = 41 } check_variable = { global.cwop_s8_item = 42 } } } }
}

# Any scope. The file in the context cannot take effect: four joint embargoes or two Fund programmes run already.
COLDWAR_OPEC_ctx_no_place = {
	OR = {
		# E1 (and E3 embargoed) needs a free record unless the target already has one; F1 needs a free Fund place
		AND = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 51 } AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 53 } check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_opt1 = 4 } } } NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_record_free = yes } NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target = global.cwop_ctx_target } check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target = global.cwop_ctx_target } check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target = global.cwop_ctx_target } check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target = global.cwop_ctx_target } } } }
		AND = { check_variable = { global.cwop_ctx_item = 50 } NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_fund_slot_free = yes } }
	}
}

# Country scope. May apply for full membership (net exporter) or associate membership (any oil producer).
COLDWAR_OPEC_may_apply = {
	is_ai = no
	NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_member = yes }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_candidate = yes }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_is_suspended = yes }
	NOT = { COLDWAR_OPEC_admission_busy = yes }
	COLDWAR_OPEC_oil_producer = yes
	COLDWAR_OPEC_free_file = yes
	has_political_power > 49
	NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_OPEC_rejoin_cooldown }
}

# Any scope. Fewer than four joint embargoes run.
COLDWAR_OPEC_record_free = {
	OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_e1_target = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_e2_target = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_e3_target = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_e4_target = 0 } }
}

# Any scope. Fewer than two Fund programmes run.
COLDWAR_OPEC_fund_slot_free = {
	OR = { check_variable = { global.cwop_f1_target = 0 } check_variable = { global.cwop_f2_target = 0 } }
}
